thread:
Maya: quick question - can we offer a 'business-hours shield' as a narrow add-on for reserved customers that prevents preemption during customer-defined windows? want feasibility and gating.
Arjun: feasible but needs timezone-aware enforcement + allocator check. simplest approach: tenancy policy with windows in UTC and allocator honor. complexity: cross-region sessions may still be preempted if routed elsewhere.
Sienna: ops note: we'll need explicit telemetry and an emergency circuit-breaker. also limit to 2 pilot tenants initially. drain window must be >=45s to avoid errors during reclaim attempts.
Priya: sales: customers ask for this specifically (fintech). they'd buy it if we include audit logs + clear pricing. we need a one-pager.
Leo: CS: pilot customer requires a contract clause and ability to toggle shield per subaccount. can we expose toggle in console for pilots?
rfc-bot: RFC created https://redwood.infra/rfc/business-hours-shield-2026 - review by EOD Tue.
Arjun: config sketch: policy: business_hours_shield; windows: [{tz: "America/Los_Angeles", start: "09:00", end: "17:00"}]; enforce_regions: true; drain_seconds: 45.
Sienna: monitoring: shield.evictions.blocked.count, shield.toggle.audit, tenant.shield.latency.p95. rollback: disable shield globally if blocked_evictions > 1% for 10m.
Maya: launch plan: RFC -> small impl (2 weeks) -> internal canary -> 2-customer pilot. owners: Arjun (impl), Sienna (ops), Priya (sales), Leo (pilot). I'll update RFC with toggles and pricing. Thanks all :thumbsup:
